features.title: Glide effortlessly with full-circle motion
features.text: The smooth swivel mechanism allows for effortless 360-degree rotation, letting you move freely and stay engaged in conversations or activities without strain.

features.title: Contrast meets class in every stitch
features.text: Upholstered in soft duo-tone fabric, the Opulent sofa strikes the perfect balance between comfort and refined style, making it a standout piece in any living space.

features.title: Light on the ground, heavy on style
features.text: Raised on sturdy legs, this sofa not only adds a touch of elegance but also makes cleaning underneath effortless, keeping your home fresh and clutter-free.

features.title: Cushioned with care
features.text: Soft foam cushions adjust to your body, providing supportive comfort whether you’re sitting upright or lounging.

features.title: Elegance meets endurance
features.text: Built with sturdy stainless steel legs, this sofa offers lasting durability and rock-solid stability, ensuring it stays as reliable and stylish as the day you brought it home.
